20:99.text: , We relate to you from the news of what has preceded. And We have certainly given you from Us a message

20:100.text: Whoever turns away from it - then indeed, he will bear on the Day of Resurrection a burden

20:101.text: and evil it is for them on the Day of Resurrection as a load -

20:102.text: The Day the Horn will be blown. And We will gather the criminals, that Day, blue-eyed.

20:103.text: They will murmur among themselves, "You remained not but ten

20:104.text: We are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner
will say, "You remained not but one day."

20:105.text: And they ask you about the mountains, so say, "My Lord will blow them away with a blast.

20:107.text: You will not see therein a depression or an elevation."

20:108.text: voices will be stilled before the Most Merciful, so you will not hear except a whisper

20:109.text: That Day, no intercession will benefit except
one to whom the Most Merciful has given permission and has accepted his word.

20:110.text: before them and what will be after them,
but they do not encompass it

20:111.text: faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining.
And he will have failed who carries injustice.

20:112.text: But he who does of righteous deeds while he is a believer - he will neither fear injustice nor deprivation.

20:113.text: And thus We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur’ān
and have diversified therein the warnings that perhaps they will avoid
or it would cause them remembrance.
